BathroomActionRequest.description:
Delete (soft), restore, or empty (for good, deleted ones only). Exactly one of `ids`
or `all`; `all` means every record the action applies to.
BathroomActionRequest.title: BathroomActionRequest

BathroomEntry.description: One bathroom record in the admin list. `deleted` ones are only listed on request.
BathroomEntry.title: BathroomEntry

BathroomLogResponse.description: Counts are for everything; the list is cut to `limit` (`truncated`).
BathroomLogResponse.title: BathroomLogResponse

BathroomVisit.description: One student leaving the room. `back_ms` is null while they are out. Times are server time.
BathroomVisit.title: BathroomVisit

BrandResponse.description: Public: what every page shows as its title and icon. Empty strings if not configured.
BrandResponse.title: BrandResponse

ClarificationOut.description: One visible clarification, as a room device sees it.
ClarificationOut.title: ClarificationOut

CreateClarificationRequest.description: Admin posts a clarification (wireframe: Admin · Clarifications). null room_ids = all.
CreateClarificationRequest.title: CreateClarificationRequest

CreateRoomRequest.description: Admin adds a room (wireframe: Admin · Timers). Duration defaults to 180 minutes.
CreateRoomRequest.title: CreateRoomRequest

ErrorCode.description: HTTP-level errors. These are NOT recorded as events (see docs/protocol.md §6.5).
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

RejectionReason.description: Why an event was recorded but not applied. Only the fold produces these.
RejectionReason.title: RejectionReason

ResetRoomRequest.description:
Admin resets a paused or finished room to a fresh, not-started timer. `session_id` is the
session the admin was looking at, so two admins can't reset twice by accident.
ResetRoomRequest.title: ResetRoomRequest

RoomPresence.description: Who has this room's pages open (staff stream only). `control` = proctor page.
RoomPresence.title: RoomPresence

RoomSnapshot.description: Everything a room device needs to show and tick the timer. Sent in full every time.
RoomSnapshot.title: RoomSnapshot

StudentInfo.description: What a proctor may see about a student: no contact details.
StudentInfo.title: StudentInfo

SuperConfig.description: Public: what the sign-in button needs. null = Google sign-in is not set up on this server.
SuperConfig.title: SuperConfig

SuperSettings.description: What the super-admin page edits. These replace the same-named .env values at runtime.
SuperSettings.title: SuperSettings

TimerSnapshot.description:
The folded timer state (plan §3.3).

remaining(now) = max(0, duration_ms + adjust_total_ms - elapsed_banked_ms
                        - (now - running_since_ms if RUNNING else 0))
TimerSnapshot.title: TimerSnapshot

UpdateClarificationRequest.description:
Exactly one of `hidden` (hide/unhide) or `body` (edit; the old wording stays visible,
struck out). `room_id` limits the action to one room. A per-room edit moves that room to
a new copy with the edited text and returns the copy (0.8.0).
UpdateClarificationRequest.title: UpdateClarificationRequest

UpdateRoomRequest.description:
Admin edits a room that has not started (wireframe: Edit…). Omitted fields are unchanged.

Duration can only change before the timer starts; use `adjust` (+/- time) once running.
UpdateRoomRequest.title: UpdateRoomRequest

UpdateSettingsRequest.description:
Omitted fields are unchanged. `log_out_old` signs out everyone who got in with a password
that this request changes (room devices for the room password, admins for the admin one).
UpdateSettingsRequest.title: UpdateSettingsRequest

info.description: Contract for room devices and staff. Prose: docs/protocol.md.
info.title: Proctor Suite protocol

post.description: Clears the cookie for one surface.
Room name (dropdown) + event password. Sets display_sid or control_sid.

get.description: Rooms for the login dropdown. No auth. Bounded (MAX_LOGIN_ROOMS).
Public: the Google client id for the sign-in button (null = not set up). 0.9.0.

post.description: Sign in with a Google ID token. Only emails on the super-admin list get a session.

get.description: Public: the site name and icon every page shows. Added in 0.9.0.

post.description: One command, idempotent on command_id. Needs X-Proctor-Client.

get.description: Who is logged in on this surface (cookies are HttpOnly, so the UI asks).
Polling fallback. Served from memory. 304 when version <= since_version.

SSE: current snapshot immediately, then every change, plus heartbeats.
`cid` is a random id the page picks so it can end this stream early (0.5.0).

200.description: text/event-stream. Frames are SnapshotMessage, HeartbeatMessage and (staff stream only) PresenceMessage.

post.description: A page is closing: end its stream now so presence updates at once. Needs X-Proctor-Client. 0.5.0.

get.description: A room's proctor or staff: one student by ID, from memory. No contact details.

Admin: bathroom records across rooms, newest first (longest out first for `out`).
`deleted=true` adds the soft-deleted ones after the live ones. Added in 0.11.0.

post.description:
Admin only (proctors can record and view, never delete): soft delete, restore, or
empty (permanent, deleted records only). 0.11.0.

get.description: Admin: every clarification, newest first, hidden included. Added in 0.6.0.

post.description: Admin posts text to all rooms (room_ids null) or a subset. Added in 0.6.0.

delete.description:
Admin deletes a clarification, or (`room_id`) from one room only. Soft since 0.8.0:
restorable until emptied. Added in 0.7.0.

patch.description:
Admin edits (`body`; old wording stays, struck out) or hides/unhides (`hidden`, one
room with `room_id`). Added in 0.6.0 as hide only; edit and per-room in 0.7.0. With
`body` and `room_id` (0.8.0) that room moves to a new edited copy, which is returned.

post.description: Admin wipes a deleted clarification from the database for good. Added in 0.8.0.
Admin undoes a delete, everywhere or (`room_id`) in one room. Added in 0.8.0.

get.description: All rooms' snapshots (staff dashboard first load).

post.description: Admin adds a room (name, duration_min default 180). Added in 0.2.0.

delete.description: Admin: soft delete (hide). Not while RUNNING or PAUSED. Signs the room out. 0.4.0.

patch.description: Admin edits duration (before start only) and/or test label. Added in 0.3.0.

post.description: Admin wipes a deleted room and its history from the database for good. 0.8.0.
Admin: fresh not-started timer for a PAUSED or ENDED room. Added in 0.4.0.
Admin: undo a soft delete. Added in 0.4.0.

get.description: Admin: the imported roster, filtered by room name (`room=` for no room) or search.

post.description: Admin: delete every roster row (privacy cleanup). `count` = students removed.
Admin: replace the roster from ContestDojo's API, only when CONTESTDOJO_* is set.

get.description:
SSE: a snapshot per room on connect, then every change in any room, plus heartbeats.
With `?clarifications=1` (0.8.0) also a `clarifications` event (the admin list, same body
as GET /api/staff/clarifications) on connect and after every clarification change.
A `room_removed` event (`{room_id}`, 0.8.0) follows an Empty of a deleted room.

200.description: text/event-stream. Frames are SnapshotMessage, HeartbeatMessage and (staff stream only) PresenceMessage.

delete.description: Remove someone added on this page. Not yourself, and not the .env ones.

get.description: Super-admin: current name, icon and the two passwords (not cached).

patch.description: Change any of them; they replace the .env values from now on. 0.9.0.

get.description: Clock-sync probe. No auth. Never touches Postgres.
